sources.citation: Phan Lương Hùng. 2022. Hệ thống nguyên âm tiếng Nùng Vẻn [The vowel system of Nung Ven]. Ngôn ngữ 2022(9): 31-35. Hà Nội: Viện Ngôn ngữ học. (Internet Archive copy of sti.vista.gov.vn/tw/Lists/TaiLieuKHCN/Attachments/351187/)
sources.note: Nothing. Articulatory + Praat F1/F2 study of 11 monophthongs and /ɯa/ (2,000-item 2022 fieldwork, Cả Tiểng, Nội Thôn, Hà Quảng); tones appear only as Chao digits in transcriptions; no mention of trọng âm/stress, syllable types or presyllables. Sec. 2 summarises Edmondson, Nguyễn Văn Lợi, Hoàng Văn Ma & Tạ Văn Thông 1999 (10-vowel system).

sources.citation: Edmondson, Jerold A. [2002 draft, PDF title 'Kra for Curzon']. Kra or Kadai languages. Pre-publication draft of the chapter published in Diller, Edmondson & Luo (eds.) 2008, The Tai-Kadai Languages, 653-677. London: Routledge. Internet Archive copy 2012-03-15 of ling.uta.edu/~jerry/byte-identical to the 2004 capture already held by the project).
sources.note: Nothing for En: En (Nùng Vên) is listed among the seven Kra languages and among those preserving codas, but the 'En.' section heading at the end of the draft is empty. Only prosodic remark is second-hand for Buyang ('sequi-syllabic structure with the first syllable being toneless', after Li 1999).
